note: Project task routing only. Hosts discover SKILL.md using their own mechanisms; if a skill is not listed by the host, read its exact path. Routes are conditional on scope and host permissions, not an instruction to invoke every candidate.

task_routes.applies_when: Answer or explain from relevant sources, without changing files or data.
Authorized document/rule changes. Verify sources, links and policy consistency. Use skill-writing only when creating or editing an actual skill.
Explore unresolved design with brainstorming; use writing-plans for multi-step work. Plan-only stops at plan; authorized implementation proceeds under SME-AI-002.

Behavior changes: meaningful regression/behavior tests, preferably test-first; small labels/docs/config use proportionate checks. Read existing plan and choose native execution; do not create mandatory subagents from plan boilerplate.
Unexpected behavior or failures: evidence and root cause before fixes.

Review a code diff against an explicit base and requirements. For WIP, inspect status, staged and unstaged diffs plus in-scope untracked files; an empty committed diff does not mean no changes. For small policy/document checks use self-review; do not silently install an issue tracker or publish findings.
Frontend changes whose appearance or interaction needs browser verification.
Compare PO requirements, specifications and current implementation; preserve unresolved domain decisions.
Model or integration work: inspect contracts and training/evaluation provenance. No automatic retraining, credit decisions or fabricated predictions.
Read scripts and target/side effects first; authorize DB effects separately when not covered. Verification skill does not grant data-write permission.
Only when an actual SKILL.md is created/edited or skill behavior is being validated. Do not rewrite imported vendors for ordinary tasks.
Only when user requests handoff or durable session context, without starting another agent or external service implicitly.

codegraph.host_usage: Codex extension and Gemini Antigravity invoke the local CLI through terminal tools; PO uses the IDE chat UI.
